tests: R58: a bundle created and revised twice answers three revisions newest first, each file's digest equal to the SHA-256 of the bytes op=image gives
R58: a multi-file set's history names every file of every revision
R58: a document with three state_history entries answers three states as stored, in the order stored
R58: a 250-revision bundle answers the newest 200 and truncated; 250 states answer the newest 200
R58: the answer carries no grade, checked or acknowledgment key, and no key of any entry is English
R58 control: a viewer who may not see the bundle, an id naming nothing and a missing viewer get one NO_SUCH_BUNDLE, byte-identical
R58 control: a call changes no row of manifest, history or files
R59: a document captured, then re-captured, answers two revisions whose capture_sha are the two captures' digests, newest first
R59 control: a revision with no capture in its snapshot answers no capture_sha, and R58's other fields are unchanged
R34 (d470): GATE_VERSION is exactly `plane-gate/1.0 (bio-checks <CATALOG_VERSION>)`, the stamp every ratification carries
R39 (d526): promotion's own refusals are asked before any registered fence: ENVELOPE_TYPE_DISAGREES reaches no step
R19 (d526): a project created with no envelope type is owned by its creator; NAME_TAKEN is answered whether or not the envelope states the type
R19 (project-disclosure): NAME_TAKEN is one answer, byte for byte, whichever project holds the name, and names neither its id nor its title
R19, R38 (project-mint): PROJECT_ID_SUPPLIED and PROJECT_ID_IN_BYTES answer one way for a held id and a never-minted one, echo no id, and carry C-59's rows
R16 (rec-181): CITED carries `to: retired` and every citing id; an edit of a cited item that keeps its state lands; the fact is read at the write
R9 (inquiry): an inquiry's recorded title is the one its `## Question` derives, whatever the envelope's words for it
R30 (subresources; N631): C-20.1's mechanical envelope admits data/snapshot-manifest.json, and nothing written outside it; a file carried unchanged from the pre-image is not written
R27 (ratify-envelope): a reference the corpus does not hold is the gate's C-6.2 error, and ok is false; the same reference held passes it
R1: base is the compare-and-swap (EXISTS, ABSENT, CAS_STALE naming expected and got; a stale base is never taken)
R1: the stale-base refusal fixture is promotion's real CAS_STALE answer, made by its code when it is called (K4993 (1))
R2: a refused promotion leaves the record exactly as it was; an accepted one commits every row in one transaction
R3: one manifest entry per accepted promotion; a creation's base is the empty-string SHA and snapshots nothing; history is never rewritten
R4: a re-send under a held snap key is answered idempotent and writes nothing; anything else there is SNAP_KEY_TAKEN
R4: a file whose digest either side does not state makes the two different — the re-send is refused (a creation's, R1's EXISTS), never idempotent
R5: every stored digest and size is of the stored bytes; a supplied digest that differs is FILE_DIGEST_MISMATCH
R6: an inline file over the 1 MiB bound is OVERSIZE_INLINE, naming the path and its length
R48: INLINE_MAX is 1,048,576 bytes, the most one file may carry inline; a larger inline file, bundle.md or any other, at creation or revision, is OVERSIZE_INLINE naming its path and bytes
R7: MALFORMED, NO_BUNDLE_MD, REFS_IN_PAYLOAD, BASIS_IN_PAYLOAD and FILES_DROPPED
R8: a mechanical promotion names a declared operation, and the manifest records writer and operation
R9: the document is the record's word on itself; a contradicting envelope is refused by name; replay is exempt from the refusal only
R10: a non-replay revision stating another type is REVISION_RETYPES_BUNDLE, naming both
R11: missing fields are refused by name or carried forward and said so; the request's own names are required
R12: created and last_updated come from the document; a disagreeing envelope and a redated revision are refused by name; a replay is exempt from the envelope refusal, not from the derivation
R13: a creation takes the recorded producing group; with none, the document's or envelope's; a revision may not regroup
R14: a non-replay promotion whose document's id differs from its bundle is refused by name (C-1.1)
R15: a state move along an undeclared edge is refused (BIAS_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION for bias, else STATE_MOVE_UNDECLARED); every declared edge passes; replay is not exempt
R16: a move into retired while a live edge cites the item is CITED, naming every citing id; an edit of a retired item is not asked
R17: readability is judged first: no bundle.md, a blob-held one or no front matter gets the same refusal whatever the type
R19: projects — the plane mints the id, titles are unique ignoring case and spacing, owners alone (de)activate, joined actors revise
R19: when no free project id can be drawn, the creation is refused MINT_EXHAUSTED through record-core's mintExhausted (its R62), and nothing is written

R6: an inline file over the 1 MiB bound is OVERSIZE_INLINE, naming the path and its length
